note: LRRC7 is established as causing autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 77, characterized primarily by neurodevelopmental and psychiatric manifestations rather than major congenital malformations or metabolic regression.

evidence.text: LRRC7 is recognized as the causative gene for intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 77.
